description: SYS notification severity routing map — determines which checker results trigger QQ push vs status-only write.

exception_alert.description: Must push to QQ — true production exception
criteria: V33 enabled (active runtime path, not historical doc)

status_only.description: Write status file only, no QQ push — normal audit result

check_v33_residual_audit.note: historical_doc_count and allowed_guard_count are always status_only; only active_v33_path blocks

check_ops_daily_operation.note: BLOCKER on any production guard (V2_VERIFIED, V4_A0, V4_B0, etc.) triggers QQ push

sys_daily_settlement_summary.note: Only MISSING or CHAIN_INCOMPLETE triggers QQ; COMPLETE is always status_only

check_v2_prod_automation_closure.note: Production automation failure is always critical

check_v4_next_scan_window_capture.note: Window capture failures are critical; future windows are status_only

v4_review_guard.note: Guard failure on formal output blocks QQ send. File in engine/v4_review_guard.py

check_v4_post_review_to_intel_mvp.exception_when: qq_sent = true (push marker shows actual send)
check_v4_post_review_to_intel_mvp.note: Review-to-intel sync is informational unless QQ was actually sent

check_v2_cron_dryrun_validation.note: Cron dry-run is informational unless QQ push path is active

check_v4_control_center.note: Canonical Control Center checker is informational; only BLOCKER triggers QQ

check_v4_goal_distribution_source_trace.note: Goal distribution source trace is informational

always_push: check_status = BLOCKER with V2/V4 production impact
never_push: allowed_guard V33 references in checker/guard files
